restaurant_name: รามคลินิกแพทย์คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: Review: Paid for my first HIFU treatment. I got 400 shots for 3000 baht. They slightly exceeded the limit during the treatment. The doctor gave excellent advice, constantly asking if I was okay with it and assessing my face to determine how much and where the treatment was needed. I saw a slight improvement immediately after the treatment, but it's starting to get better. You can ask the doctor about any facial problems you have. The clinic has been open for over ten years, and everything is done by the doctor. Importantly, they have two cats! The clinic looks a bit scary from the outside, but inside it's very homey. I was a little scared at first, but the staff were attentive, the doctor was friendly, and most importantly, they didn't push any sales at all. I repeat, they didn't sell anything!

restaurant_name: รามคลินิกแพทย์คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: I received treatment at this clinic. The doctor is a middle-aged man with a friendly demeanor. The staff are attentive, and the service fees are reasonable. The examination and treatment rooms are well-partitioned. It's located near Big C Ramkhamhaeng.

restaurant_name: รามคลินิกแพทย์คลินิกเวชกรรม
text: The clinic does open a little after 9 am, but the doctor usually arrives at work almost at 11 am. Don't waste your time waiting. If you're honest with your patients and those who come for treatment, please put up a sign indicating the doctor's arrival time in the future. It wastes the time of people who intend to seek treatment. Anyone who wants to use your services can come, but I recommend going somewhere else.
